const nums: number[] = [1, 2, 3];
const ro: readonly number[] = [1];
const withUndefined: (number|undefined)[] = [undefined];
const prefix: [number?, ...number[]] = [];
const headRest: [number, ...number[]] = [1];
const suffix: [...number[], number] = [1];
const a: [number?,...number[]] = nums;
const b: readonly [number?,...number[]] = ro;
const f: [number?,...string[]] = nums;
const i: [number?, boolean?, ...number[]] = nums;
const j: [number?, ...number[]] = withUndefined;
const k: [number?, number?, ...number[]] = headRest;
const l: [number?, number?, ...number[]] = suffix;
const m: [number?, number?, ...number[]] = prefix;
const n: [number?, ...string[]] = [];
const q: [number, ...number[]] = [1] as const;
function total(values: [number?, ...number[]]): number { return values.length; }
console.log(total(nums), a.length, b.length, f.length, i.length, j.length, k.length, l.length, m.length, n.length, q.length);
function optionalBeforeGeneric<T extends number[]>(values: number[]): [number?, ...T] { return values; }
console.log(optionalBeforeGeneric<number[]>(nums).length);
